overview.description: The Direxion MU Defined Income Boost ETF (MUIB) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Cboe MU Defined Income index. The fund is an income-focused ETF that uses swap contracts to track an index that systematically attempts to produce a target amount of annual income based on selling weekly out-of-the-money call options on the stock of Micron Technology, Inc., while maintaining upside participation through a daily delta hedging strategy. MUIB was launched on Jul 29, 2026 and is issued by Direxion.
